نختط (form VIII)
# نَخْتَطِ (naḵtaṭi) /nax.ta.tˤi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# نُخْتَطَ (nuḵtaṭa) /nux.ta.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
